absent: Implementation of checksum update primitives, little and big endian thirty two bit routines, Castagnoli routine and bit reversal.
Contents of the character classification table and behavior for values outside the unsigned byte range.
Enabled implementation of debug object tracking, including state transitions, locking, hashing and fixup policies.
External bitmap companions for larger sizes, bit numbering, mask construction and first, last, clear and select primitives.
Byte order handling and group semantics for eight wide clump search beyond stepping by eight from zero.
Core generic allocator behavior for adding, allocating and freeing chunks, placement algorithms, locking and NUMA handling.
Device tree pool lookup behavior when enabled beyond the null returning configuration shown.
Hash distribution, word size selection details and callers of pointer hashing.
Hash list bucket layout, initialization effects, concurrency rules and iteration guarantees.
Internal class machinery behind lock guards, error encoding and exact conditional failure conditions.

findings.text: This lane provides a family of macros that create scoped lock holder types for a chosen lock. Declaring a guard introduces a small holder object plus a constructor that acquires the given lock and a destructor tied to compiler cleanup that releases it, so leaving the scope automatically unlocks. Unconditional forms always hold the lock, while conditional forms record success or failure inside the holder and expose separate helpers to obtain the protected pointer and the numeric outcome. A with style helper combines construction with a cleanup bound temporary to hold the lock for one statement or block.

The fragments expose small inline checksum adapters. One computes a storage integrity checksum over a byte range starting from a zero seed by delegating to an update routine. One adapts a generic entry point to the little endian thirty two bit variant. Two ethernet helpers seed the little endian checksum with all ones, one returning the value directly and the other returning a bit reversed form. A further helper reports available accelerations and in this configuration returns zero.
Checksum acceleration capabilities are reported as distinct low bit flags with numeric values one for little endian, two for big endian and four for Castagnoli.
Standard thirty two bit checksum polynomials are fixed. The little endian IEEE value is 0xedb88320, the big endian IEEE value is 0x04c11db7, and the little endian Castagnoli value is 0x82f63b78.

Character classification uses eight single bit masks. Uppercase is 0x01, lowercase is 0x02, digit is 0x04, control is 0x08, punctuation is 0x10, whitespace is 0x20, hex digit extension is 0x40 and hard space is 0x80.

Classification predicates consult a shared table indexed by the input byte and test combinations of the masks. Alphanumeric combines upper lower and digit, alphabetic combines upper and lower, control tests control alone, graphic combines punctuation upper lower and digit, lower and upper test their single bits, printable adds hard space to the graphic plus punctuation set, punctuation tests punctuation alone, whitespace tests whitespace alone, and hex digit combines digit with the hex extension. Two further helpers test whether a value fits in seven bits and force seven bit range by clearing the high bit.

Digit testing appears in two compatible spellings, one delegating to a compiler builtin and one accepting only zero to nine by direct comparison, while octal digit testing accepts zero to seven. Case conversion offers helpers that shift an uppercase ASCII letter down and a lowercase letter up only when the input belongs to the corresponding class, plus an unconditional helper that sets the 0x20 bit and short aliases for the conditional conversions.

Object tracking uses a fixed ordered enumeration with values for none, initialized, inactive, active, destroyed, not available and an upper bound marking the count. The fragments show only names and order, not allowed transitions or triggering operations.

The tracking record contains a hash list link, a current state value from the enumeration, an additional numeric state field, a choice between a generic object pointer and a pointer used as a batch tail, and a constant pointer to a descriptor supplying callbacks. The choice field occupies one pointer width.

The descriptor holds a constant name string and a set of callbacks. One suggests a debug representation for an address, one reports whether an address denotes a static object, and five report whether to repair unexpected conditions during initialization, activation, destruction, freeing and assertion of initialization. Each repair callback receives an address and a state and returns a boolean.

In the configuration shown the object debugging interface is inert. Initialization, stack initialization, deactivation, destruction, freeing, assertion of initialization, early initialization, memory initialization and the freed range check perform no observable action, while activation returns zero without doing work. Address based operations take an address and a descriptor, the freed check takes an address and a size.

Four forward search helpers locate the next interesting position at or after an offset within a bounded length. One finds a bit set in both inputs, one finds a bit set in the first but clear in the second, one finds a bit set in either input, and one finds a clear bit in a single input. Small compile time lengths are handled directly with range masking and first set or first clear selection, larger cases delegate to external companions. An offset at or beyond the length yields the length as a not found sentinel.

Three helpers locate the nth matching position counted from zero. One counts set bits in a single bitmap, one counts positions set in two bitmaps, and one counts positions set in the first two but clear in a third. A requested index at or beyond the length immediately yields the length. Small constant lengths resolve directly with masking and selection, other cases delegate outward.

Four helpers query from the start or the end of a range. Three return the first position satisfying a conjunction of two or three inputs or a two input difference, or the length when none matches. One returns the last set bit in a single bitmap or the length when empty. Small constant lengths use direct masking with first set or last set selection, otherwise they delegate.

Three helpers implement wrapped search over a circular range. Two search forward from an offset to the end and, when nothing is found and the offset is nonzero, restart from zero up to the offset, returning the length when neither part matches. The third supports iteration by distinguishing whether the cursor has already wrapped and choosing the appropriate segment, again returning the length when no further match exists before the start.

Iteration helpers repeatedly invoke the search primitives to walk matches. Single bit forms visit every position satisfying a two input conjunction, difference or disjunction, or every set or clear bit, with variants that resume from a caller supplied cursor instead of zero. Range forms report consecutive runs by pairing a set search with a following clear search or the reverse, again with from cursor variants. A wrap form cycles from a start position through the end then the beginning, and an eight wide group form steps by eight through nonzero groups, with a first group helper starting at zero.

Little endian search variants have two configurations in the fragments. In one they forward to the native search helpers with the same arguments. In the other they apply byte swapping before masking and then use first set or first clear selection for small constant lengths, otherwise delegating to dedicated little endian companions. Both preserve the convention that out of range offsets and missing matches yield the length.

A pool object holds a spin lock, a list of chunks, a minimum allocation order, a function pointer selecting placement within a chunk, an opaque data pointer for that function, and an optional name. The placement function receives bitmap and size information and returns a placement index. The fragments show only the types, not synchronization or allocation policy.

A chunk record links into its pool, tracks available space with an atomic long, records a physical start address, an opaque owner pointer returned at allocation time, a virtual start address and an inclusive virtual end address, followed by a trailing flexible bitmap tracking suballocation within the chunk.
Two small parameter blocks tune allocation. One carries an alignment in bytes for the start address, the other carries an offset selecting a fixed region. Each holds a single integer field.

Inline wrappers adapt core chunk management. One adds a virtual range with explicit physical backing, one adds a range with no valid physical address by passing negative one, three allocate by forwarding size plus algorithm and data or owner selections to a common allocator, one frees by forwarding to a common free routine with a null owner, and one device tree lookup unconditionally returns null in this configuration.

Hashing uses golden ratio multipliers. The thirty two bit value is 0x61C88647 and the sixty four bit value is 0x61C8864680B583EB. Word size selects which multiplier is named prime and whether the generic long hash aliases the thirty two or sixty four bit helper.

Thirty two bit hashing multiplies by the thirty two bit constant and keeps high bits by shifting right according to the requested output width. Sixty four bit hashing either multiplies by the sixty four bit constant and keeps high bits on sixty four bit words or folds high and low halves with thirty two bit steps on smaller words. Pointer helpers hash an address as an integer or fold a sixty four bit address by exclusive or of halves and truncation.

Hash table helpers declare fixed size arrays of hash list heads where the size is two raised to a bits parameter. One form defines and initializes every bucket, one defines a read mostly variant with the same initialization, one merely declares the array, and two helpers derive bucket count from array size and bit count from bucket count via base two logarithm.

Each header in this lane uses a conventional single inclusion guard macro that is defined once to prevent repeated inclusion. The fragments show only the guard definitions, not any functional effect beyond idempotent inclusion.

Callers must treat a result equal to the length as not found rather than as a valid index, since every search returns the length for missing matches, for offsets beyond the range and for nth requests beyond the range. Masks exclude bits outside the valid interval, so words must never be interpreted without that masking. Iteration advances the cursor past each match, so the fragments show no protection if the bitmap changes during traversal.

The bitmap search, hash and character classification helpers shown are queries over caller supplied memory. They take pointers plus lengths and offsets and return positions or truth values, with no lock operation, allocation or retained state visible in the fragments. Correctness depends on the caller providing readable storage covering the stated length and a stable bitmap across an iteration loop.
External compile time size predicate used to select inline versus delegated bitmap paths.
